title: Many tried; four Gospels (Luke Hom. 1 on Luke 1:1)
english: [[Since many have undertaken to compile a narrative of the things fulfilled among us >> Bible:Luke 1:1]], Origen opens the Luke homilies: many tried, few finished; the church receives four evangelists chosen by the Lord. Luke writes for Theophilus so he may know the [[truth of the words in which he was instructed >> Bible:Luke 1:4]].

added_allusions.reason: eyewitnesses and ministers of the word

translator_notes: Copy-text Jerome Latin of Luke Hom. 1 (Rauer GCS 35 tradition); no ANF 9 Patrick wording.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
